data.description: Bonus action: you and one ally within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + Confidence modifier. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

data.duration: until start of your next turn
data.description: Action: allies within 30 feet (including you) add +1d4 on attack rolls and rolls against fear until the start of your next turn. Once per short rest.
You and allies within 10 feet have advantage on Endurance and Judgment rolls against shove, fear, or forced movement.
Draw Breath may target an ally within 5 feet instead of you.
Reaction when an ally within 30 feet drops to 0 HP: they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you and allies within 30 feet add your Confidence modifier (min +1) to damage rolls and cannot be frightened.
Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One mark; replacing ends the old. Scales Brand d6 every 5.
When your Grudge target hits you, reaction: one weapon attack against it.
While Grudge is active, the first time each turn the marked creature damages you, it takes necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
When you hit your Grudge target, you may forgo Grudge bonus damage to impose disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
You may maintain two Grudge marks. Retaliate once per marked attacker per round.
Once per long rest, when a Grudge target drops you below half HP, your next Attack action against it before the end of your next turn crits on 18-20 and adds 3d8 per hit.
Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon, deal an extra 1d8 damage. If the hit drops the target to 0 hit points, regain hit points equal to your Warrior level.
When you drop a creature to 0 hit points with a weapon attack, as a bonus action move up to half your speed and make one melee weapon attack against a different creature.
After Harvest, your next weapon attack before the end of your next turn has advantage.
As an action, make one melee attack against each creature of your choice within 10 feet. Once per short rest.
On a critical hit with a weapon, regain one spent Draw Breath use, or gain temporary hit points equal to Warrior level if none are spent.

Once per long rest when you hit with a melee weapon, the target makes an Endurance roll vs Might DC; on a failure it drops to 0 if it has 100 HP or fewer, otherwise (or on success) it takes 10d10 necrotic.
Melee spell attacks and touch cantrips deal +1d6 necrotic; hit target has disadvantage on Might rolls until the end of your next turn.
Bonus action: infect a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; 1d6 necrotic at start of its turns; Endurance vs Confidence DC ends. Once per short rest.
When you drop a creature to 0 with necrotic damage, gain temporary HP equal to Witch level + Confidence.
Action: 15-ft-radius field within 60 feet for 1 minute; enemies starting turn there take 2d6 necrotic. Once per short rest.
While you have temporary HP from Witch features, spell attacks deal +1d8 necrotic.
Once per long rest as an action, 1 minute: 30-ft darkness you and allies see through; enemies take 2d8 necrotic at turn start (Judgment vs Confidence DC halves).
When casting a Witch spell of 1st rank+, lose HP equal to slot rank to add 1d8 necrotic to one target (or restore 1d8 for healing spells).

description: Once per turn, when you cast a Witch spell or deal Hex damage, lose HP equal to 2 × Proficiency Bonus (can't be reduced) and choose: the spell's save DC is +1, or the damage gains +2d6 necrotic.
Action: lose up to your Witch level in HP; one ally within 30 ft regains twice that. Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest.

data.description: Action: spend up to proficiency bonus hit dice; each die deals 1d6 necrotic to a creature within 60 feet (Judgment roll vs Confidence DC halves).
Action: creature within 30 feet makes Endurance roll vs Confidence DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats roll each turn). You lose 1d6 HP. Once per short rest.

description: Once per turn, when you deal Hex bonus damage, you regain HP equal to that damage.

data.description: Action: a hexed or Crimson-Bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 necrotic (Endurance vs Confidence DC halves). Once per short rest.

description: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft damages you: it takes necrotic damage equal to half the damage dealt and can't regain HP until the end of its next turn. Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest.

data.description: Reaction: ally within 30 feet is hit; you take the damage instead with resistance to it. Once per short rest.

description: New Greater Curse option, Bleeding: the target takes 3d8 necrotic at the start of each of its turns and you regain half of it (save ends).

data.description: Once per long rest as an action, drop to 1 HP and choose up to 6 creatures within 30 feet: each regains 8d8 HP or each enemy takes 8d8 necrotic (Judgment halves). Cannot mix heal and harm.

description: You can use Blood Price twice per turn.
Bonus action, 1 use per long rest: lose HP equal to 10 × a slot tier (8th tier max) to regain one expended slot of that tier.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: Blood Price costs no HP, Vampiric Hex also heals one ally within 30 ft for the same amount, and you resist all damage from creatures you've hexed.

data.description: Bonus action: hex a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. First time each turn it takes damage from you, +1d6 necrotic. Move hex as bonus action if it drops to 0. One hex.

description: Your Hex lasts 8 hours. When a hexed creature drops to 0 HP, you can move the Hex to a new target within range with no action.
Once per turn, when you damage a hexed creature, end its Hex to deal an extra 1d8 necrotic per two Witch levels. Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest.

data.description: Maintain two hexes at once.
When a hexed creature fails a roll against your spell DC, chosen creatures within 10 feet of it take 1d6 necrotic.

description: Once per turn, when a hexed creature takes your Hex damage, one other creature you choose within 10 ft of it takes the same bonus damage.

data.description: Reaction when a hexed creature hits: impose -1d6 on the attack roll after seeing it. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per rest: curse a 20-ft-radius area within 60 ft. Enemies there take -2 on saves against your spells and hexes and treat it as difficult terrain.

data.description: When a hexed creature dies, reaction: place that hex on a new creature within 30 feet of it.

description: Once per day, place a minor Hex on one creature until the next dawn. It doesn't count toward your limit, carries the base disadvantage and one rider, and only remove-curse-level magic ends it.

data.description: Once per long rest as an action, hex every enemy within 30 feet for 1 minute; hex die for this casting is 2d6.

description: Your Hex bonus damage becomes 3d6.
Action, 1 use per long rest: Hex every creature you choose within 60 ft for 1 minute (they don't count toward your limit). Hex bonus damage still applies once per turn total.

Action, 1 use per long rest, a hexed creature within 60 ft: Confidence roll. On a failure, for 1 minute it can't cast spells, has disadvantage on all d20 rolls, and loses one legendary resistance use; on a success it is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

data.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet rolls a d20, add or subtract 1d4. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

description: Reaction when an ally within 30 ft makes an attack roll, save, or check: it rerolls and uses either result. Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest.
You have 3 doom dice (d6), regained on a short or long rest. Once per turn, after a creature you can see within 60 ft rolls a d20, spend one to add it to or subtract it from the roll.

data.description: Reaction: force a creature within 60 feet to reroll a d20; they use the new result. Once per short rest.
Bonus action: learn a creature within 30 feet's HP band (healthy/bloodied/critical) and whether it has daily auto-success rolls left. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

description: Reaction: force a creature within 60 ft to reroll an attack roll, save, or check and use the lower result. 1 use per rest (2 at 18).

data.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet takes damage, reduce it by 2d10 + Confidence. Once per short rest.

description: Reaction when an attack would hit you: the attack misses and you teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see. 1 use per rest.

data.description: Once per long rest, after seeing a d20 within 60 feet but before outcome, replace the result with 10.

description: When you place a Hex, roll a d20 and note it. Once while that Hex lasts, replace one of the target's d20 rolls with the noted number.

options: undo one forced move or teleport
reroll one failed check (keep new result)
reverse one social or skill outcome
data.description: Once per long rest as an action, choose one creature within 60 feet (or yourself) and reverse or replace one mechanical outcome that occurred since the start of your last turn. Valid targets include: one damage instance, one condition application or removal, one forced move or teleport, one failed check (reroll it and use the new result), or one social or skill outcome (a persuasion/insight/performance-style contest or check result). Death after a completed death sequence cannot be undone. The Guide may block world-scale or multi-creature events beyond character scale. Range 60 feet.

description: Doom dice become d8 and you gain a 4th die.
1 use per long rest, at the end of a round: choose up to 3 d20 rolls made that round; each is rerolled and the new results stand.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: doom dice become d12 and aren't spent when used (still once per turn per creature).

data.description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Your weapon attacks against it deal +1d6 necrotic, and it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you while within 5 feet of you.
When your mark deals damage to an ally, you may use your reaction to move up to your speed toward it and make one melee attack.
Heavenly Strike using necrotic adds +1d8 and the target makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is blinded until the end of its next turn.
Your mark lasts 10 minutes and persists if you are incapacitated (not dead). You may have two marks.
Once per short rest when you hit your mark, deal extra 3d8 necrotic and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you know the direction to your mark regardless of distance on the same plane, your speed increases by 20 feet toward it, and critical hits against it deal +4d8 necrotic.
Heavenly Strike may deal necrotic instead of radiant. Against undead, add +1d8.
Bonus action: your weapon sheds 1d6 necrotic for 1 minute; when you drop a creature to 0, one enemy within 10 feet takes 1d6 necrotic. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
While you are below half HP, add your Judgment modifier to melee damage (min +1).
Action: gain temporary HP equal to 2d10 + Templar level and resistance to necrotic and radiant for 1 minute. Once per short rest.
When you reduce an undead or fiend to 0 HP, you may force a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC; on a failure it is destroyed and cannot reform by common means for 24 hours.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute undead and fiends within 30 feet have disadvantage on attacks against you, and your Heavenly Strike free trigger deals 3d8 necrotic or radiant.
When you roll initiative, you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus + Judgment modifier.
Bonus action: one ally within 30 feet adds 1d6 to their next attack roll or roll against a condition before the start of your next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
You have advantage on rolls against fear and charm. Allies within 10 feet may use your Judgment modifier in place of theirs once per short rest when failing such a roll (reaction).
Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet fails a death roll, treat it as a success. Once per short rest.
When you restore HP to a creature at 0 HP, it may stand (costs no movement) and make one weapon attack as a reaction.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute dying allies within 30 feet are stable at the start of their turns and regain 1 HP if still at 0 when they stabilize this way.
When you heal with Grace or a Templar spell, the target also gains temporary HP equal to your Judgment modifier (min 1).
Action: restore 2d8 + Judgment HP to each creature of your choice within 15 feet. Once per short rest.
While you haven't moved since the start of your turn, allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC and you have advantage on rolls against being moved.
Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet is hit, grant them resistance to that damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
Action: 20-ft-radius sanctuary for 1 minute. Allies ending turn there regain 1d8 HP; enemies treat the area as difficult terrain. Once per long rest.
Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 feet would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP and gain temporary HP equal to your Templar level + Judgment.
During a long rest, etch a rune on a weapon or armor you touch. Weapon: +1d4 damage of a chosen type. Armor: +1 AC. One rune active; lasts until next long rest.
Bonus action: activate a prepared combat glyph (blast 2d6 in 10 ft, or shield +2 AC until start of next turn). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).
You may maintain two etched runes. Battle Scribe glyphs deal 3d6.
Reaction: when hit, expend a glyph to gain resistance to that damage and push the attacker 10 feet (Might roll vs Intellect DC negates push). Once per short rest free; or spend a Battle Scribe use.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your weapon rune damage becomes +2d8, your AC rune becomes +3, and Battle Scribe does not expend uses.
Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet to a space you can see. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.
After a long rest, choose one prepared Mage spell of 1st or 2nd rank; you may cast it once without a slot before your next long rest.
When you cast a single-target Mage spell of 1st-4th rank, once per short rest also affect a second creature within 10 feet of the first.
Action: you and allies within 10 feet become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or 10 minutes pass. Once per short rest.
Reaction: when you are hit, teleport up to 30 feet and the attacker makes an Intellect roll vs your Intellect DC or misses. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute create three illusory duplicates (as a mirror image effect with 3 images) and your Dream Step has unlimited uses during that minute.
Bonus action: create a simple nonmagical object (up to 5 lb) for 1 hour or until dismissed. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
Action: summon an unseen servant (AC 12, HP = 5 x Mage level, speed 30) for 1 hour. It can do simple labor and take the Help action. Once per short rest.
Conjuration spells of 1st-3rd rank with casting time action may be cast as a bonus action once per short rest.
When you summon a creature with a Mage spell, add your proficiency bonus to its AC and attack rolls for the duration.
Once per long rest when you cast a conjuration that summons one creature, summon two instead (shared duration; both vanish when the spell ends).

Once per long rest as an action, open a gate for 1 minute to a known location on the same plane within 100 miles, or summon a single powerful allied spirit (Guide profile) for 1 minute that obeys your commands.
Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or force). Your cantrips and Mage spells that deal that damage type add +1d4. Change attunement on a long rest.
When you cast an area Mage spell, choose up to Intellect modifier creatures (min 1) in the area; they automatically succeed on their rolls and take no damage.
Once per turn when you roll damage for your attuned element, reroll any 1s on those dice.
Attuned-element spells ignore resistance (not immunity).

When you cast a Mage spell of 5th rank or lower that deals damage, maximum damage on the dice. You take 2d12 force per spell rank afterward. Once per long rest (or risk again: each extra use until long rest adds +1d12 to the backlash).
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you gain immunity to your attuned element, your cantrips of that type deal +2d8, and enemies that hit you in melee take 2d8 of that type.
Legion can call constructs (armor +1 AC, immunity to poison and psychic). Constructs can be repaired with Scrap Field Repair.

description: Your lesser template becomes Scrap Drone: Small construct, fly 30 ft (hover), walk 10 ft, immune to poison and psychic damage and the poisoned, charmed, and exhaustion conditions; Bolt Launcher is a ranged spell attack (60 ft, piercing); during a short rest you can restore all its HP without rebinding. From 5, your greater template is Iron Sentinel: Medium construct, AC 15 + Proficiency Bonus, speed 25 ft, reach 5 ft, same immunities, Piston Fist deals bludgeoning; Guard Protocol: reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against you from a creature within 5 ft of it.
Bonus action, 1 use per rest: one construct summon gets +10 ft speed and one extra strike each turn for 1 minute; when it ends, the construct takes force damage equal to 2 × your Proficiency Bonus.

data.description: Bonus action: one construct within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Intellect HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
During a short rest, grant one construct a module: reach +5 ft, speed +10 ft, or +1d6 damage. Lasts until next long rest.

description: Your constructs gain +1 AC while within 5 ft of another of your constructs, and you gain +1 AC while within 5 ft of one.

data.description: Bonus action: one construct gains an extra action on its next turn, then takes 2d8 force backlash. Once per short rest.

description: Action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: merge your constructs into one Large Siege Frame (AC 16 + Proficiency Bonus, HP equal to their combined current HP, two strikes of 3d10 + Proficiency Bonus bludgeoning, double damage to objects and structures). When it ends, they separate with the HP left split evenly.

data.description: Constructs add your proficiency bonus to Endurance rolls and automatically succeed on rolls against fear.

description: Action, 1 use per long rest: bind an extra Iron Sentinel for 1 minute outside your capacity.

data.description: Once per long rest as an action, expend a 5th-rank summoning slot (or your highest) to call a Huge construct for 1 minute (Guide titan profile) that does not count against Legion cap.

description: You can rebind a destroyed construct as a bonus action once per turn (it returns at half HP), and Field Repair works on all your constructs as an action once per rest.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: each of your constructs can take one extra action on each of its turns (Attack or Dodge only).

data.description: Legion can call Hollow spirits (insubstantial; resistance to nonmagical weapons; vulnerable to radiant). Hollows ignore difficult terrain.

description: Your summons are Hollow (a creature type: mana-drained husks; features that affect undead also affect Hollow). Lesser template Hollow Husk: Medium, speed 30 ft, climb 30 ft (no fly), resists necrotic, Clutching Rot deals necrotic; Hunger: once per turn +Proficiency Bonus damage to a creature below half HP. From 5, greater template Hollow Brute: Large, speed 30 ft, climb 20 ft, reach 10 ft, resists necrotic, Rending Swipe deals bludgeoning and gives the target disadvantage on its next Endurance roll. Spark: when your Hollow summon hits a concentrating creature, it has disadvantage on that concentration save.
Once per turn when a Hollow summon deals Hunger damage, you or another summon within 30 ft gains temporary HP equal to that damage.

data.description: When a Hollow hits, you may deal 1d6 psychic instead of its normal bonus and the target has disadvantage on its next Judgment roll before your next turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
Action: expend a 2nd-rank or higher summoning slot to call three Tiny Hollow swarmlets that share one turn and one HP pool (use swarm profile). Once per short rest.

description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 ft for 1 minute. Your summons have advantage on attacks against it, and it can't regain HP above half its maximum.

data.description: Bonus action: teleport yourself or one Hollow up to 30 feet to a space either of you can see. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

description: Your binding capacity is 1 point higher, but the extra point can only hold a Hollow Husk.

data.description: Forced Command can target two Hollows at once (one use).

description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest, story-gated: your summons gain +Proficiency Bonus damage and advantage on attacks. When it ends, roll a d6 per summon; on a 1 that summon breaks free and becomes hostile until it's destroyed or rebound. The DM may rule that breaking the seal draws attention.

data.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute all Hollows within 60 feet gain +2 to AC and attacks, and enemies that start their turn within 5 feet of two or more Hollows take 2d8 psychic.

description: Enemies that start their turn within 10 ft of any of your Hollow summons take necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and have disadvantage on concentration saves until their next turn.

Reaction, 1 use per long rest: when you see a creature within 60 ft cast a spell, it makes a Confidence roll vs your spell DC. On a failure the spell fails and you regain an expended slot of its tier (6th max).

data.description: When you use Legion with a summoning slot, you may raise a skeleton or zombie profile instead of a standard summon. Undead summons have +1 AC.

description: Your lesser template becomes Bone Servant: Medium undead, speed 30 ft (no fly), immune to poison damage and the poisoned, exhaustion, and charmed conditions, Rusted Blade deals slashing or piercing; doesn't need air, food, or sleep. From 5, your greater template is Grave Guard: Medium undead, reach 5 ft, same immunities, Grave Blade deals necrotic and a creature it hits can't regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Action, 1 use per rest: an undead within 30 ft with CR no higher than half your Summoner level makes a Judgment roll or obeys you for 1 minute (it doesn't use capacity).

data.description: When an undead summon within 30 feet hits, you may use your reaction to deal 1d6 necrotic to the target or regain 1d6 HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
Bonus action: sacrifice an undead summon within 30 feet; you gain temporary HP equal to twice its remaining HP (max 40). Once per short rest.

description: 1 use per rest: when a creature dies within 30 ft of one of your summons, you regain Proficiency Bonus + Confidence modifier HP and can raise it as an extra Bone Servant for 1 minute outside your capacity.

data.description: One undead summon can remain active for 24 hours without counting against your Legion cap overnight (still counts in combat encounters). Refresh on long rest.

description: Action, 1 use per rest: raise up to Confidence modifier corpses within 30 ft as Bone Servants at half HP for 1 minute, outside your capacity.

data.description: When an undead summon drops to 0, enemies within 10 feet of it take 2d8 necrotic (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves).

description: Your Grave Guard gains +2 AC, makes two Grave Blade attacks per Attack action, and can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against you from within 5 ft of it.

data.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute undead summons have advantage on attacks and when they hit the target makes an Endurance roll vs Intellect DC or is frightened until end of its next turn.

description: Your Bone Servants take half damage from area effects. Remnant Army has 2 uses per rest and raises servants at full HP.

Action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: open a door within 30 ft. At the start of each of your turns a full-HP Bone Servant steps out (outside capacity, max 5). Creatures that start their turn within 10 ft of the door make a Endurance roll or take 4d10 necrotic.

data.description: You cast spells using the half-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Intellect.
You may use Precision for spell attacks with Assassin spells. When you use Extra Attack, replace one attack with a cantrip that requires an attack roll.

Reaction: when targeted by an attack you can see, impose disadvantage on the attack, or redirect it to a creature within 5 feet of you (other than attacker) if the redirected target is willing or fails a Precision contest vs you. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
When you cast an Assassin spell of 1st rank+ while hidden, the target has disadvantage on rolls against its DC, or you have advantage on the spell attack.

When a creature within 30 feet casts a spell of 3rd rank or lower, reaction: make an Intellect contest vs their casting stat; on a success you negate it and may cast that spell once before a long rest using your slots. Once per long rest.
Bonus action: arcane mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; your weapon and spell attacks against it deal +1d6 force. Scales Brand d6 every 5 from 15.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you have advantage on Confidence and Precision rolls, Misdirection does not expend uses, and Arcane Ambush applies even when not hidden.
Action: alter your appearance (clothing, face, height within 1 foot) for 1 hour. Inspection contests Judgment vs your Confidence. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
When you Hide, you may move 10 feet without revealing yourself. Shadowstep distance for teleport (when gained) increases by 10 feet.
Advantage on rolls to avoid tracking, and magic that would locate you has disadvantage or requires a Judgment contest vs your Precision.
Bonus action: move through occupied spaces and objects as difficult terrain this turn; end in an unoccupied space. If inside an object at end of turn, take 2d10 force and eject. Once per short rest.
Action: create a perfect illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute. It mimics your movements; attacks against you have 50% chance to hit the double instead. Once per short rest.

Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you are ethereal (move through creatures/objects; attack into material with disadvantage unless using magical weapons; resistance to nonmagical damage).

During a long rest, prepare doses of toxin equal to proficiency bonus. Apply as a bonus action to a weapon for 1 minute. First hit deals 1d6 poison and Endurance vs Precision DC or poisoned until end of its next turn.
Hidden Blade may deal poison damage. When it does, target has disadvantage on Endurance rolls until the end of your next turn.
Toxin damage becomes 2d6 and poisoned lasts 1 minute (repeats Endurance at end of turns).
A poisoned creature takes 1d6 poison at the start of each of its turns while poisoned.
Once per short rest when toxin hits, creatures within 5 feet of the target make Endurance vs Precision DC or also become poisoned for 1 minute.
Once per long rest, a toxin hit deals 6d6 poison (Endurance halves) and on a failure the target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

Bonus action: whisper to a creature within 60 feet that can hear you; it makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
When a creature fails a roll against your fear effects, mark it for 1 minute; your Shade spells deal +1d6 psychic to it.

You may speak telepathically to any creature within 60 feet. Once per short rest, plant a one-sentence suggestion; Judgment vs Judgment DC to resist for 1 hour (harmful acts auto-fail the suggestion).
Action: ask three questions of lingering shades within 30 feet (truthful short answers). Once per short rest.
Bonus action: you and one ally within 30 feet become lightly obscured and ignore disadvantage from darkness for 10 minutes. Once per short rest.

Once per long rest as an action, each enemy within 30 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is frightened for 1 minute and takes 4d8 psychic; repeats each turn. On success, half damage and no fear.
Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it has disadvantage on the first attack each turn against creatures other than you.
Action: target within 30 feet makes a Might roll vs Judgment DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.
Reaction: when a marked creature casts a spell, force a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC; on a failure the spell is wasted. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
Action: 15-ft-radius circle for 1 minute. Chosen creatures cannot leave or enter without succeeding on a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC. Once per short rest.

Action: marked creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is banished for 1 minute (repeats each turn; ends if you lose concentration-equivalent: if you drop to 0 or willingly end). Once per long rest.
Once per long rest as an action, bind a creature within 30 feet: it is restrained and silenced for 1 minute; it may make one Judgment roll at the end of each turn at disadvantage to end the seal.
When you restore HP with a Priest spell or Grace-like feature, add your Judgment modifier (min +1). Once per turn also grant 1d6 temporary HP.
Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet gains +2 AC for 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
When you cast a single-target Priest healing spell, a second creature within 15 feet of the target regains HP equal to half the amount (rounded up).
Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet fails an Endurance or Judgment roll, add 1d8 to the result. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.
Once per long rest when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 HP, they instead drop to 1 HP and regain 4d8 + Judgment HP.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet regain 2d8 HP at the start of their turns and enemies that hit them take 1d8 radiant.

While furious, you may dual-wield two-handed melee weapons. When you take the Attack action with one of them, you may make one attack with the other as a bonus action (same dual-wield rhythm as the Assassin: one off-hand attack on the bonus action). The off-hand attack uses the weapon's normal damage die and your Might modifier.
Bonus action while furious: grow one size for 1 minute (reach +5 ft, advantage on Might checks, weapons deal +1d4). Once per Fury.
Once per turn while furious and grown or dual-wielding great weapons, a melee hit deals +1d8 and the target makes a Might roll vs your Might DC or is knocked prone.
While furious, gain temporary HP equal to your Berserker level when you enter Fury, and +1 AC.
Giant's Growth: +1d8 weapon damage, reach +5 ft stacks with size, and you may grow even if not furious once per long rest for 1 minute.

Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute grow two sizes (Huge if you started Medium), keep Bone Grip dual-wield (one off-hand great-weapon attack as a bonus action), and Crushing Blow becomes +2d8.
While furious, your melee deals +1d4 lightning. Once per Fury as a bonus action, bolt a creature within 30 feet for 1d8 lightning (Speed roll vs Might DC halves).
While furious, ignore difficult terrain; when you Dash, deal 1d6 lightning to one creature you pass within 5 feet of.
While furious, resistance to lightning and thunder; advantage on rolls against being moved by wind or water.
Action while furious: enemies within 15 feet make an Endurance roll vs Might DC or take 3d8 thunder and are deafened 1 minute. Once per short rest.
While furious, at the start of your turn enemies within 5 feet take 1d6 lightning.
Once per long rest as an action while furious, for 1 minute your melee lightning becomes +2d6, bolt becomes 3d8, and Living Storm is 2d6.
While furious, once per turn when you hit with melee, deal +1d6 and the target bleeds: 1d4 at the start of each of its turns until it regains HP or 1 minute passes.
Bleed dice become 1d6. Critical hits apply bleed automatically without using the once-per-turn limit.
When a bleeding creature within 30 feet takes bleed damage, you regain HP equal to half the bleed damage (rounded up).
While furious, creatures that hit you with melee take 1d6 piercing. Scales Ongoing d6 every 5 from 13.
Bonus action while furious: end all bleeds you applied within 60 feet; deal remaining bleed dice as necrotic and regain that much HP. Once per short rest.
Once per long rest as a bonus action while furious, for 1 minute your once-per-turn thorn damage becomes +2d8, bleed is 2d6, and Barbed Hide is 2d6.
Action: assume a beast form (CR 1 or lower) for 1 hour. Retain Judgment and HP; use beast stats otherwise. Uses = 2 per short rest.
Advantage on initiative. If surprised, you may still act if you enter Beast Shape first on your turn.
Beast form attacks count as magical. Once per turn +1d6 damage in beast or hybrid form.
Bonus action: hybrid form 10 minutes — keep hands/speech, natural weapons 1d8, AC 13 + Precision, speed +10. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.
Allies within 10 feet gain +1 to attack rolls while you are in beast or hybrid form. Your beast forms may be CR 3.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute hybrid form has Extra Attack (two natural attacks), Primal Strikes +2d6, and Pack Leader aura 30 feet.
When you cast a Seer spell at night or in moonlight, add +1d4 to one damage or healing roll. In darkness you see 30 feet without penalty.
Reaction: when hit, gain +1d8 temporary HP that apply to that hit first. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.
Action: creatures in a 10-ft radius within 60 feet take 3d6 radiant (Speed vs Judgment DC halves). Once per short rest.
After a long rest, choose Full (healing spells +1d8), Crescent (spell save DC +1), or New (first spell each combat does not provoke and has advantage on spell attack).
Action: 20-ft radius within 60 feet becomes magical darkness for 1 minute that you and allies can see through. Enemies starting turn there take 2d6 cold. Once per long rest.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute gain all three moon phases at once and Starfall recharges on each of your turns (still an action).
You gain a beast companion (CR 1/4 or lower). It acts on your turn; you command it as a bonus action. If it dies, ritual 8 hours to bond another.
Action: summon a swarm of tiny beasts for 1 minute (Guide swarm profile). Once per short rest.
Share senses with your companion or a beast within 100 feet for 10 minutes as an action. Once per short rest free; or expend a spell slot of 1st+.
You and your companion have advantage on attacks against a creature if the other is within 5 feet of it and not incapacitated.
You may have two companions (shared bonus-action command: both take the commanded action), or one companion and a flock simultaneously.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute all beasts of your choice within 60 feet are friendly and may each make one attack against a target you choose when summoned to act.
Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or water/force). Unarmed strikes deal +1d4 of that type. Change on long rest.
When you Flurry, you may move 10 feet before or between strikes without provoking.
Reaction: when hit by a melee attack, Speed contest vs attacker's Might or Precision; on success take half damage and the attacker takes the other half as your element type.
Action: 15-ft cone of your element, 4d6 damage (Speed vs Precision DC halves). Once per short rest.
At the start of your turn, if you moved 0 feet since the start of your last turn, regain 1 Drive and gain +1 AC until you move.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Flurry does not cost Drive, Flowing Element becomes +2d6, and Redirect Flow auto-succeeds once per turn.
Bonus action: analyze a creature within 30 feet; until the end of your next turn your unarmed attacks against it ignore 2 AC from armor/shield and deal +1d4.
When you hit the same creature twice in a turn, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn (stacks to -3).
Once per turn add Precision modifier again as bonus damage against a Weak Point target (min +1).
Action: one melee unarmed attack with advantage; on hit destroy a nonmagical shield or reduce magical AC bonus by 1 for 1 minute. Once per short rest.
When you crit with unarmed, deal +3d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Weak Point is permanent on one target, Armor Crack stacks to -5, and Precise Blow applies to every hit against it.
Once per turn when you hit with unarmed, the target has disadvantage on rolls to maintain ongoing spells until the start of your next turn, and you deal +1d4 force.
Reaction: when targeted by a spell, add +1d6 to AC or to a roll against its DC. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

When you succeed on a roll against a single-target spell of 3rd rank or lower, you may use your reaction to redirect it to another creature within 30 feet of you (original caster's roll or your Precision for attack).
When you hit with Null Strike, the target cannot cast spells with verbal components until the end of its next turn (Endurance vs Precision DC).
Once per short rest when you hit a creature concentrating on a spell (or maintaining an ongoing spell effect), it takes +3d8 force and the roll to keep the spell has disadvantage.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute your unarmed strikes end ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on the target on a hit (Judgment vs Precision DC for 6th+).
Beast companion CR 1/4+. Commands as bonus action; shares your initiative. Bond ritual 8 hours if slain.
While within 30 feet of your companion, you both add +1d4 to damage against your Bounty. You can transfer HP (action) up to your Ranger level between you once per short rest.
When you hit your Bounty, your companion may use its reaction to make one attack against it.
You and your companion have blindsight 10 feet and advantage on Judgment checks to detect hidden creatures.
When you use Volley or Extra Attack, your companion may Dash or Attack as part of your bonus action command without spending the bonus action (once per turn).
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your companion grows one size, gains +2 AC and Extra Attack, and Pack Hunt triggers on every hit against your Bounty.
After observing a creature for 1 round, learn its resistances, immunities, and one special action. Advantage on Bounty attacks against aberrations, monstrosities, and undead.

Action: set a trap in a 5-ft space (1 minute to hide it). First enemy to enter takes 2d8 damage (type chosen) and Speed vs Precision DC or is restrained 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
Your weapon attacks against shapechangers and undead count as silvered and deal +1d6.
Reaction: when an enemy within 5 feet moves away, opportunity attack with advantage; on hit speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.
Once per turn against a studied monster type, +2d6 damage and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute choose a creature type; your attacks against that type crit on 18-20 and ignore resistance to weapon damage.
Advantage on Confidence and Judgment checks to extract information. After 1 minute of questioning, know if the creature knowingly lied (Judgment contest).
Bonus action: restrain a grappled or willing creature (escape DC = your Precision DC). While restrained this way, disadvantage on spell attacks and rolls against spell DCs.
Against humanoids marked as Bounty, weapon attacks deal +1d6 and you have advantage on rolls to detect illusions and disguises.
Your Bounty lasts 24 hours. You ignore the first exhaustion from forced marches when pursuing it.
Once per short rest when you hit your Bounty, it makes a Judgment roll vs Precision DC or is incapacitated until the end of its next turn and takes +2d8 damage.

Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute humanoid enemies within 30 feet cannot Hide from you, your Bounty damage applies to all humanoids, and Manacles can be applied as a reaction when you hit.
You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

When you cast a Reaver spell of 1st rank+, you may deal +1d6 necrotic to one target and become lightly corrupted until a short rest (Guide tracks corruption; at 3 stacks disadvantage on Judgment social rolls until long rest).
Cantrip: ranged spell attack 60 feet, 1d10 necrotic; scales Cantrip d10. On hit, target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Aura 10 feet: enemies starting turn there take 1d4 necrotic. Scales Ongoing d4 every 5 from 9.
Action: creature within 60 feet makes Endurance vs Confidence DC or takes 4d8 necrotic and is poisoned 1 minute. Once per short rest.

Once per long rest when you hit with a spell or Dark Strike, the target makes an Endurance roll vs Confidence DC; on a failure ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on it end, and it takes +4d8 necrotic.

Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Decay Aura becomes 30 feet and 2d6, Corrupt Spell +2d6, and Blight Bolt hits all creatures in a 10-ft radius of the primary target (one attack roll vs each).
Your weapon houses a devil. It is magical. Bonus action: for 1 minute the devil aids you (+1d4 damage; you may reroll one damage die per hit). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

description: Proficiency in Misdirection and Awareness. You can speak mind-to-mind with your devil up to 1 mile.

Third caster from level 3, using Confidence (spell DC = class DC; spell attack = proficiency + Confidence). Cantrips: 2 at L3, 3 at L10. Spells known: 3 at L3 up to 18 at L30. Possession list only, up to 4th tier; slots return on a long rest. Casting never costs or restores Temper and never adds or removes Strain or Crossing (Fray still applies to concentration).
Bonus action, 1 Temper: teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space within 5 ft of a creature you can see (any light).

data.description: While Possessed Weapon is active, +1 AC and resistance to fire. When hit by melee, the attacker takes 1d4 fire.
Spend 1 Soul as a free action when you hit to add 2d6 fire or necrotic (devil's choice when bound).

description: Action, gain 1 Strain: a creature within 60 ft makes a Judgment roll (class DC) or is charmed by you for 1 minute; ends if it takes damage.

data.description: Once per short rest, the devil acts independently: as a reaction it makes one weapon attack using your bonuses when a creature within 5 feet attacks you.

description: Invisible while you're in darkness and haven't moved.

data.description: Bonus action: let the devil overtake you for 1 minute — advantage on Might and Confidence, +2d6 fire on melee, must attack if able each turn. Once per long rest.

description: Action, 1 per long rest: a creature charmed by you fights for you for 1 minute.

data.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you and the devil act in unison: Extra Attack grants one additional attack, Augment costs no Soul once per turn, and Infernal Armor reflects 2d6 fire.

description: Enemies within 20 ft of you can't speak or use verbal components.
Crossing effect: on a failed control save, the devil turns on your enemies instead of you; each enemy within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll (class DC) or is frightened.

data.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.

description: Bonus action: mark a creature as Indebted. When it damages you, your next Soul Strike hit on it deals extra damage equal to what it dealt (max 2 x your level).
Reaction: when an Indebted creature makes a save, it subtracts 1d6.

data.description: Reaction: when hit, gain resistance to that damage and teleport 10 feet. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.
You can see into the ethereal within 30 feet. Attacks against ethereal creatures within reach have no disadvantage from that state.

description: Action, gain 1 Strain: end one condition on you and impose it on a creature within 30 ft.

data.description: When you Veilwalk, your next attack before the end of the turn has advantage and qualifies for Dark Strike even if already used this turn (still once for the extra trigger).

description: Regain 1 Temper whenever an Indebted creature fails a save.

data.description: Action: create a linked pair of gates within 60 feet for 1 minute; any creature entering one exits the other. Once per short rest.

description: Action, 1 per long rest: an Indebted creature makes a Confidence roll (class DC) or loses its next turn.

data.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Veilwalk has unlimited uses, range 60 feet, and Phase Shift does not expend uses.

description: Indebted can be on up to 3 creatures at once.
Crossing effect: on a failed control save, the devil collects from your enemies instead of you; every Indebted creature takes 6d8 force.

data.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature below half its HP maximum, deal +1d8. Against creatures at 0 HP you may choose to knock out instead of kill.
When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, make one melee attack against a different creature within reach as part of the same attack (once per turn).
While you are below half HP, +2 to melee damage and advantage on Might rolls.
Critical hits with melee weapons deal +2d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Might DC or is frightened of you for 1 minute.
Action: one melee attack with advantage; on hit +4d8 and if the target has 50 HP or fewer after the hit it drops to 0. Once per short rest.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Executioner applies to all hits (+2d8), Cleave can chain a second time, and Reaping Blow threshold becomes 100 HP.
While wielding a shield, allies within 5 feet gain +1 AC. You can shove as a bonus action.
Reaction: when an ally within 5 feet is hit, take the hit instead (damage applies to you). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
Action: until the start of your next turn, +2 AC and resistance to a damage type you choose when you activate. Uses = Endurance modifier (min 1) per long rest.
Bonus action: enemies within 15 feet make a Judgment roll vs Might DC or must target you with their next attack before the end of their next turn if able.
Intercept grants you resistance to the redirected damage. Shield Wall becomes +2 AC to allies within 5 feet.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Intercept has unlimited range 30 feet, Fortress is permanent for the duration, and you have resistance to all damage.
Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d6 and you or an ally within 30 feet gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

Bonus action: challenge a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. It has disadvantage on attacks against others while within 5 feet of you; you have advantage on attacks against it. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.
Action: plant a banner (30-ft aura, 1 minute). Allies add +1 to attack rolls. Once per short rest.
Against your Challenge target, critical hits on 19-20 and they cannot make opportunity attacks against creatures other than you.
When an ally within 30 feet hits your Challenge target, you may use your reaction to make one melee attack against it.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Glory Strike becomes +2d6, Challenge has unlimited uses, and Herald's Banner is always active.

Bonus action: create a 30-ft line of silk between two points or to a surface; it is difficult terrain for enemies and can be climbed by you without checks. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Lasts 1 minute.
Action: creature within 30 feet makes a Speed roll vs Precision DC or is restrained by silk 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.
You ignore difficult terrain from webs/silk. Opportunity attacks with spears have advantage against restrained creatures.
Once per turn when you hit, the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn (Speed vs Precision DC negates).
You can walk on walls and ceilings while touching silk or Web Line. Bonus action teleport up to 20 feet along your silk.

Once per long rest as an action, fill a 30-ft cube within 60 feet with silk for 1 minute: enemies treat it as difficult terrain, are lightly obscured to others, and at the start of their turns make Speed vs Precision DC or are restrained until they escape.
Bonus action: take a coiled stance until you move. Your next spear attack has advantage and deals +1d6; if it hits, you may move 10 feet without provoking.
Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d4 poison and Endurance vs Precision DC or poisoned until end of its next turn.
Reaction: when a creature enters your reach, make one spear attack. Uses = Precision modifier (min 1) per long rest.
While coiled or after a Coil attack, +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
When you hit with Coil's attack, make one additional spear attack against the same target as part of that bonus action.

Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Venom Fang becomes 2d6 poison and a failed Endurance roll also incapacitates until the end of the target's next turn; Coil does not require staying still.
When you Leap or fall at least 10 feet before an attack, the attack has advantage and deals +1d6.
Leap distance doubles. You take no falling damage from leaps of your own making.

When you hit after a Leap, you may grapple the target (Precision contest vs Might or Precision). While grappled this way, you both remain aloft if you Leap again with them (they fall if released midair).
Ranged thrown spear attack 30/90; returns to your hand after the attack. Deals Spearwork bonus.
Advantage on Precision checks relying on sight. Once per turn ignore half cover with spear attacks.
Once per long rest as an action, Leap any distance within 120 feet and make Whirlwind on landing; each hit deals +2d8 and Dive Strike applies.
Bonus action: a creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Confidence DC or is charmed until the end of your next turn (hostile acts end it). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
Verse of Dissonance: enemies also have disadvantage on Judgment rolls while in the aura.
Cantrip-like action: one creature within 60 feet takes 2d6 necrotic (Judgment vs Confidence DC halves). Scales Cantrip d6-equivalent as Burst. Uses at will.
When a creature charmed by you takes damage from your spells, it takes +1d8 psychic and the charm does not auto-end from that damage (still ends on other allies harming it).
Action: enemies within 30 feet make Judgment vs Confidence DC or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat each turn). Once per short rest.

Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Thorned Lullaby auto-succeeds once per turn (still costs bonus action), Wilting Note deals 4d6, and frightened enemies take 2d6 psychic at the start of their turns.
Verse of Courage also adds +1d4 to allies' damage rolls.
Bonus action: one ally within 30 feet gains advantage on their next attack and +1d6 damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
When you deal damage with a Songsmith cantrip or spell, add +1d6 fire once per cast.
Dissonance also deals 1d6 fire to an enemy the first time it hits an ally each turn.
Action: allies within 30 feet gain +2 to attacks and damage for 1 minute. Once per long rest.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute War Hymn becomes +2d6 damage, Burning Chorus +2d6 fire, and Anthem is active.
When you restore HP with a Songsmith spell or feature, add 1d6. Once per turn grant the target +1 AC until the start of your next turn.
Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Confidence HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.
Verse of Courage also causes allies to regain 1d4 HP at the start of their turns.
Action: heal three creatures within 30 feet for 3d8 + Confidence. Once per short rest.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet automatically succeed on death rolls and regain 2d8 HP at the start of their turns.
Learn Virtue Invocations. Bonus action: touch a creature to restore 1d8 + Intellect HP. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.
When Siphon Grace heals you, an ally within 30 feet also regains HP equal to your Intellect modifier (min 1).
Advantage on rolls against charm and possession. Once per short rest as a reaction, grant that advantage to an ally within 30 feet for one roll.
When you finish a short rest, you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your Wraith level.
Action: transfer any number of your temporary HP to allies within 30 feet, or spend a short-rest slot to heal all allies within 30 feet for 2d8 + Intellect. Once per short rest for the slot heal.
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Virtue's Mend does not expend uses, Shared Grace heals twice Intellect, and allies within 30 feet have resistance to necrotic and psychic.
Learn Seraphim Invocations. Bonus action: for 1 minute gain fly speed 30 feet (hover). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. While flying, Grace Bolt fire die becomes 1d6.
When Grace Bolt hits, the target takes +1d6 fire at the start of its next turn unless it spends its action to extinguish (no roll).
Once per turn, add Intellect modifier again as radiant damage to one Grace Bolt hit.
Action: creatures of your choice within a 30-ft cone make a Judgment roll vs Intellect DC or are blinded until the end of their next turn. Once per short rest.
Grace Bolt may deal all fire or all radiant. When you hit three or more targets, deal +2d6 fire to each.

Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Burning Wings is permanent, Holy Flame becomes 2d6, and Grace Bolt gains a 15-ft radius burst option (Speed vs Intellect DC; half on success) dealing Grace Bolt damage once.

Learn the Nephilim Invocation list. Bonus action: bind a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.
Your melee weapon attacks deal +1d4 radiant. You may use Intellect for attack and damage with simple melee weapons.
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).
Once per turn when you hit a bound creature with a weapon or Grace Bolt, deal +2d6 radiant and pull it up to 10 feet toward you.
Action: a bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 radiant (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves) and is knocked prone on a failure. Once per short rest.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you fight as if you had Extra Attack(2) (2 extra attacks, 3 total), Grace-Edged becomes +2d6, and Enochian Binding does not expend uses.

description: Gain medium armor and proficiency with the Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed and Versatile weapon categories. You do not gain shields: the Witch Knight fights with a weapon in one hand and casts with the other.
You have +2 AC against a creature you've hexed, and medium armor doesn't hinder your spellcasting.
Once per turn, when you hit a hexed target with a melee attack, choose: its speed drops by 10 ft until the start of your next turn, or it has disadvantage on its next attack.
When you take the Attack action with a melee weapon, you make 2 attacks.
You resist necrotic and psychic damage from creatures you've hexed. When a hexed creature hits you, you can spend an Evil Eye use as a reaction against it.
Bonus action: Dash toward a hexed target. Your next melee attack against it this turn has advantage and adds your Confidence modifier to damage.
Bond two weapons. You can deliver Greater Curse through a melee hit (the target saves as normal) instead of using an action.
You can replace one attack of your Attack action with a Witch cantrip.
Allies within 10 ft of you share your Hex Guard bonus.
1 use per long rest, 1 minute: every melee hit you land applies your Hex to the target.
Bonus action, at will: brand a creature within 30 ft for 1 minute (one at a time). While within 10 ft of you it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.
Reaction when a creature within 5 ft of you is hit: you become the target and it uses your AC.
Bonus action: you and up to 3 allies within 30 ft gain temporary HP equal to 1d10 + half your Warrior level. 1 use per rest (2 at 17).
Once per turn, when you hit the creature marked by Hold the Line, its speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.
You have advantage on Might and Endurance rolls, and you can't be pushed, pulled, or knocked prone against your will while you're conscious.
Ground within 15 ft of you is difficult terrain for creatures hostile to you. Once per turn you can make an opportunity attack without spending your reaction.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: allies within 10 ft of you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, Interpose costs no uses, and the marked creature can't willingly leave your reach.

Bonus action, spend an Inspiration use: a creature within 60 ft takes necrotic damage equal to the Inspiration die + Confidence modifier and has disadvantage on its next save before the end of your next turn.
You and allies within 30 ft resist necrotic damage and roll death saves with advantage.

Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per rest: a 20-ft-radius sphere of silence within 60 ft. Creatures you choose are unaffected; others inside can't hear or cast spells with verbal components.
While you perform Countercharm, enemies within 15 ft of you have their speed halved. Once per turn, when an enemy dies within 30 ft of you, regain an Inspiration use.

Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: the echo of a creature that died within 30 ft in the last minute rises beside you. Once on each of your turns it strikes a target within 30 ft (your spell attack, 2d10 + Confidence necrotic).
Once per turn, Tolling Note doesn't spend a use, and it also hits each creature you choose within 10 ft of the target.

Action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: enemies within 60 ft make a Judgment roll at the start of each of their turns, taking 6d10 psychic and being frightened until the end of that turn on a failure (half, not frightened, on a success). Allies there add your Inspiration die to their first attack roll each turn.
Bonus action: spend embers to heal one creature within 30 ft 1d8 per point (max points per use = Proficiency Bonus). Not a spell or prayer.
Reaction, 2 embers, gain 1 Crack: an ally within 30 ft who fails a save succeeds instead.
When Grace Leech heals you, one ally within 30 ft regains the same amount.
Action, 2 embers, gain 1 Crack: 15-ft aura on you for 1 minute; allies in it have resistance to one damage type you pick.

Action, 1 use per long rest: a creature within your reach that died within the last minute returns to life with 1 HP. You gain 2 Cracks (this can trigger a Breach). Can't target yourself or be used at 0 HP; a creature can't be brought back this way more than once per long rest, and it fails on death by old age or a missing vital part.
Healing from Rite of the Virtue features is maximized.
On a failed Breach save, instead of being stunned, every ally within 60 ft regains HP equal to half its HP maximum (no Virtue Breach effect).

Once per turn, when you take the Attack action, give up one attack to let an ally within 30 ft who can see or hear you use its reaction to make one weapon attack, adding a command die (d6; d8 at 10, d10 at 18, d12 at 24) to the damage.
Bonus action: up to 3 allies within 30 ft who can hear you regain HP equal to your Warrior level. 1 use per rest (2 at 18).
Once per turn, when you hit a creature, the next attack roll an ally makes against it before the start of your next turn has advantage.

When you roll initiative, you and allies within 30 ft gain temporary HP equal to your Warrior level. Once per long rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft fails a save, it can reroll and use the new roll.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: plant a banner in your space. Allies within 20 ft of it add 1d4 to attack rolls and saves and can't be frightened.
Aura, 30 ft, always on: allies add +2 to weapon damage rolls. One Commander's Strike can now send two allies to attack (each uses its own reaction).

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: up to 4 allies within 30 ft can each use a reaction to move half their speed and make one weapon attack. For the duration, Commander's Strike doesn't cost you an attack.
A creature that succeeds on a save against your damaging cantrip still takes half damage. Ward recharge: when you cast a damaging spell with a slot, your Arcane Ward regains 2 × the slot's tier.
When you cast an area spell, choose up to 1 + the spell's tier creatures you can see; they automatically succeed on its save and take no damage from it.
Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. You resist that damage type and add your Intellect modifier to one damage roll of each spell you cast that deals it.
Once per turn, when you roll damage for a Mage spell, reroll up to your Intellect modifier in damage dice and use the new rolls.
1 use per long rest: when you cast an area damage spell of 5th tier or lower, double its area; creatures that fail its save are also knocked prone.
Action, 1 use per long rest: a 150-ft line, 10 ft wide. Each creature in it makes a Precision roll, taking 20d10 force damage on a failure or half on a success; objects and structures take double.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: you gain a 60 ft fly speed (hover) and resistance to lightning and your Affinity type. At the start of each of your turns, creatures you choose within 15 ft make a Precision roll or take 4d10 lightning damage (half on a success). Your cantrips deal maximum damage.

Proficiencies: Elegant One-Handed and Versatile weapon categories, and light armor; you can cast Mage spells while wearing light armor. Runes: you inscribe runes on items: 10 minutes per rune (can be done during a rest), no gold cost, permanent until removed, swapped freely on a long rest. Runes per item: 1 (2 at 10, 3 at 24). Active runes: 2 (3 at 6, 4 at 10, 5 at 14, 6 at 18, 7 at 24, 8 at 28); inscribing past the limit ends your oldest rune. One rune of each name per item, and one damage-rider rune (Ember, Rime, Spark, Gall) per weapon. Allies can use your runed items while you're alive and on the same plane. Runed weapon: choose one weapon carrying at least one of your runes; you use Intellect instead of Might or Precision for its attack and damage rolls (change it on a long rest). Runic Strike: once per turn, when you hit with your runed weapon, the hit deals an extra 1d6 force damage (2d6 at 10, 3d6 at 18, 4d6 at 24). The rune limits and rune prerequisites rise at 6, 10, 14, 18, 24 and 28. Rune-Hardened: your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each Mage level you have, and by 1 more each time you gain a Mage level.

Ward recharge: once per turn, when you hit with your runed weapon, your Arcane Ward regains HP equal to your Intellect modifier (up to its maximum). Weave Attack: when you take the Attack action with your runed weapon, you can attack twice; you can replace one of those attacks with casting a Mage cantrip that takes an action (three attacks at 24).

Runic Strike becomes 2d6. When Runic Strike hits, you can brand one rune on the target until the start of your next turn: Binding (the target makes a Might roll against your spell save DC; on a failure its speed is 0) or Sundering (the next attack roll against the target before then has advantage). Once per turn (tied to Runic Strike).

When you hit a creature with your runed weapon, you can detonate a glyph on it (no action; declare on the hit). Each creature of your choice within 10 ft of the target (including the target) makes a Precision roll against your spell save DC, taking 5d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success. Uses: Intellect modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per rest: +2 AC, advantage on concentration saves, and a creature that hits you with a melee attack from within 5 ft takes force damage equal to your Intellect modifier. Runic Strike becomes 3d6.
Runic Strike becomes 4d6. Weave Attack gives 3 attacks (one can still be a cantrip). Bind Rune can brand both runes on one hit.

Once per long rest, when you hit a creature with your runed weapon, you speak its unmaking-name. The target makes a Endurance roll against your spell save DC. On a failure it takes 10d10 force damage and loses one damage resistance or immunity of your choice for 1 minute; on a success it takes half damage and loses nothing. Legends (story-gated) have advantage on the save.
Channel Divinity, action: enemies of your choice within 30 ft make a Endurance roll, taking 2d10 + Priest level radiant on a failure or half on a success (undead and Hollow have disadvantage).
Reaction when an ally within 30 ft takes damage: reduce it by 2d6 + Judgment modifier. Judgment modifier uses per long rest.

Once per turn, when your Priest cantrip or spell deals damage, add your Judgment modifier as radiant damage; a creature hit sheds dim light and can't benefit from being invisible until your next turn.
One use of Disciple's Touch can heal up to 3 creatures within range.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per rest: you shed bright light 30 ft, resist radiant and necrotic damage, and enemies that start their turn within 10 ft of you take radiant damage equal to Judgment modifier + Proficiency Bonus.
Sun Mantle has unlimited uses, and allies within its light resist necrotic damage.

Action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: true sunlight fills 120 ft around you and dispels magical darkness of 8th tier or lower. Enemies in it have disadvantage on attack rolls, allies starting their turn in it regain Judgment modifier HP, and undead and Hollow starting there take 4d10 radiant.
Bonus action, Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest: a spirit, undead, fiend, or Hollow within 60 ft makes a Confidence roll or is restrained for 1 minute (save ends).
Reaction, 1 use per rest: when you or an ally within 30 ft would be possessed, charmed, or frightened, the effect fails.

Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per rest: a 15-ft-radius circle within 60 ft. Undead, fiends, spirits, and Hollow can't willingly enter or leave it, and those inside have disadvantage on attack rolls.
Your damage against undead and Hollow ignores resistance, and your Destroy threshold is 2 higher against Hollow.

Action, 1 use per long rest: a creature within 60 ft makes a Confidence roll or can't teleport, change planes, or turn ethereal for 1 minute. A sealed creature that dies within that minute can't be raised or reanimated.
Seal works on any creature type and can target two creatures per use.

Action, 1 use per long rest: a creature within 60 ft makes a Confidence roll. On a failure it's incapacitated and restrained for 1 minute with no repeat save; on a success it's restrained until the end of its next turn. Legends can spend a legendary resistance as normal.
Bonus action: send a whisper only one creature within 60 ft can hear (it can reply the same way). Once per rest, touching a creature dead less than 1 minute, you hear its last thoughts.
You see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 60 ft, and you know when a creature you can see within 30 ft tells a deliberate lie.
1 use per rest: a creature that heard your whisper within the last hour makes a Judgment roll or must answer one question truthfully.

Bonus action: become a whisper and move up to 30 ft through dim light or darkness without provoking, passing through creatures; you and allies within 5 ft of where you stop gain half cover until your next turn.
You and allies within 120 ft can speak telepathically, and they have advantage on saves against being charmed.

Bonus action, Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest: up to Judgment modifier creatures within 60 ft hear dreadful whispers; each makes a Judgment roll or takes 4d8 psychic and is frightened until the end of its next turn (half, not frightened, on a success).
1 use per long rest: compel the full truth from a willing or defeated foe.

Learn 2 skills (any) and 2 languages. You can cast any ritual spell in your book as a ritual without preparing it. Ward recharge: when you finish a short rest, your Arcane Ward regains half its capacity.

After each long rest roll 2d20 and record them (3 at 18). Once per turn you can replace an attack roll, save, or check by a creature you can see with one of these rolls, before the roll is made. Unused dice are lost at your next long rest.
1 use per rest: when you see a creature within 60 ft cast a spell of a tier you can cast, you learn it for 8 hours and can cast it once with your own slot. It counts as a Mage spell for you.
You have advantage on Intellect rolls, resistance to psychic damage, and your memories can't be altered by magic without your consent. You prepare 2 extra spells.
You recall perfectly anything you saw or heard in the last month. Portent Study gives 3 dice. Once per long rest, spend 1 minute to swap all your prepared spells.

You gain truesight to 60 ft and can't be surprised. Once per long rest, ask the DM about one creature you can see: its resistances, immunities, vulnerabilities, and current HP are revealed truthfully.

Action, 1 use per long rest: cast any Mage spell of 8th tier or lower without a slot or components, or undo one roll or effect from the last round (it is rerolled or never happened). Story-gated: the DM may rule a legend's key moments can't be rewritten.

Oath Channel, action: one creature within 30 ft makes a Might roll or is restrained for 1 minute (save ends), and one ally within 30 ft gains 5 + Paladin level temporary HP. Oath spells: Warm Hands, Grasping Vines (3rd tier at 9: Second Breath, Overgrowth).
You and allies in your aura resist poison damage, reduce necrotic damage taken by your Confidence modifier, and have advantage on saves against being moved or knocked prone.
Once per turn, when you use Divine Smite, you or an ally in your aura regains HP equal to half the smite's extra damage.
1 per long rest, when you drop to 0 HP and aren't killed: you are stable, and at the start of your next turn you regain HP equal to 2 x your Paladin level and stand up.

Your Avatar form sheds green-gold bright light 30 ft and grants a 30 ft fly speed. At the start of each of your turns you regain 10 HP (if above 0), and when you score a critical hit, you and allies in your aura regain HP equal to your Confidence modifier.
Allies in your aura who start their turn with at least 1 HP regain HP equal to your Confidence modifier, and they also resist necrotic damage.

Action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: you and allies in your aura can't be moved, knocked prone, or restrained against their will and gain temporary HP equal to your Paladin level at the start of each of their turns.
Your Hex damage can be poison. While a creature is hexed, ground within 5 ft of it is difficult terrain for your enemies.

Bonus action, choose: an ally within 30 ft regains 1d6 + Confidence modifier HP, or a hexed target makes a Endurance roll or is slowed (speed halved until the end of its next turn). Confidence modifier uses per long rest.
1 use per rest: a hexed target is restrained (Might roll ends); attacks against it have advantage.
1 use per rest: become invisible, or gain three-quarters cover while among plants, for 1 minute. Also 1 use per rest: your party leaves no tracks for 10 minutes.
New Greater Curse option: the target is rooted (speed 0) and takes 2d6 poison at the start of each of its turns. If it dies while cursed, a hostile bloom hexes a new enemy within 30 ft.
Bloom & Blight uses double and its heal becomes 2d6 + Confidence modifier.
Aura 15 ft: allies ignore plant-based difficult terrain and enemies don't. Your Hex damage becomes poison and ignores nonmagical resistance.
1 use per long rest, 1 minute: use Bloom & Blight once each turn for free; hexed enemies automatically fail their first poison save.

Bonus action, Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest: mark an undead, spirit, or Hollow creature within 60 ft for 1 minute. It can't regain HP, and your weapon hits on it deal +1d6 necrotic. Oath spells: Spirit Sense, Hallowed Refuge (3rd tier at 9: Waking the Dead, Spirit Ring).
You and allies in your aura can't be charmed or frightened by undead and roll death saves with advantage.
Your Divine Smite deals +2d8 against undead and Hollow creatures. When a smite kills a creature, its spirit truthfully answers one question you ask within the next minute.
Action, 1 use per rest: every dying ally in your aura becomes stable and regains HP equal to your Confidence modifier.

Your Avatar form wears a red-oak mantle and grants the fear aura: an enemy that starts its turn within 10 ft of you makes a Judgment roll or is frightened until the end of its turn. You see invisible and ethereal spirits within 60 ft, and once during the Avatar you can use Turn the Unholy / Bind the Hollow as a bonus action without spending Oath Channel.

Action, 1 use per long rest: each enemy of your choice within 60 ft makes a Confidence roll. Undead and Hollow take 10d10 radiant and are turned for 1 minute on a failure (half, not turned, on a success); other enemies take 5d10 necrotic (half on a success).

10-minute ritual, 1 use per long rest, story-gated: call the willing soul of someone who died within the last 10 days. It appears for 1 hour, can speak and act with its former abilities, and can't be forced to stay. The DM decides which souls can answer.

Bonus action, Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest: outline a creature within 60 ft in starlight for 1 minute. It gains no benefit from invisibility or being hidden against you or your allies, and your attacks on it score a critical hit on 19–20 until you hit it with Divine Smite. Oath spells: Glowmark, Starlance (3rd tier at 9: Noonlight, Spellbreak).
Your aura sheds dim starlight. You and allies in it have advantage on saves against illusions and being charmed.
Once per turn, the radiant damage of your Divine Smite ignores resistance, and the target makes a Endurance roll or is knocked prone.
Action, 1 use per rest: one creature within 60 ft makes a Judgment roll or is incapacitated for 1 minute (save ends).
Your Avatar form grants a 60 ft fly speed (hover). Your smite damage is split evenly between force and radiant.

Action, 1 use per long rest: enemies of your choice within 30 ft make a Endurance roll, taking 12d10 radiant and being blinded until the end of their next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: every enemy in your aura is Star Marked, and you and allies in your aura have truesight to 60 ft.

Mounting or dismounting costs 5 ft of movement, and you have advantage on saves to stay in the saddle. While mounted, a lance has 10 ft reach, can be used one-handed, and has no disadvantage against adjacent targets. Reaction: when an attack hits your mount, it hits you instead.

Once per turn, if you (or your mount) move at least 20 ft straight toward a creature and then hit it with a melee attack, deal +1d8 damage and it makes a Might roll or falls prone. Your mount's movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from creatures you hit this turn.
When you hit a mounted creature, or a Large or smaller creature with a charge, it makes a Might roll or is dismounted and knocked prone.
Wheeling Charge damage becomes 2d8. When you take the Attack action while mounted, your mount can make one attack using your Proficiency Bonus in place of its own.
1 use per rest, if you have no living mount: summon a spectral warhorse for 1 hour (AC 13 + Proficiency Bonus, HP 5 × Knight level, speed 60 ft). It acts on your turn and obeys your commands.
Your mount can move through hostile creatures' spaces. Each creature it passes through makes a Precision roll or takes 2d8 bludgeoning and falls prone.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: allies within 30 ft gain +20 ft speed and their movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Your Wheeling Charge deals maximum damage, and creatures it hits make a Judgment roll or are frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
Reaction while wielding a shield, when an ally within 5 ft is hit: add 2 + your Proficiency Bonus to its AC against that attack, possibly turning the hit into a miss.
While you wield a shield, at the start of each of your turns choose one ally within 5 ft; until your next turn it uses your AC if yours is higher.
Reaction when a creature moves at least 10 ft toward you and ends within your reach: make an opportunity attack with advantage. On a hit, its speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.
You and allies adjacent to you have half cover against ranged attacks and advantage on Might rolls.
You can't be moved or knocked prone against your will, and the ground within your reach is difficult terrain for enemies.
Unbreakable Guard works for allies within 15 ft: you move to a space adjacent to them first without provoking. Interpose adds 4 + your Proficiency Bonus instead.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 per long rest: allies within 15 ft have three-quarters cover, you gain temp HP equal to your Knight level at the start of each turn, and once per turn you can Interpose without a reaction.

After a short or long rest, designate one willing creature as your VIP. Reaction when a creature attacks your VIP within 10 ft of you: swap places with the VIP and become the attack's target (it uses your AC).
When a creature attacks your VIP, you can Challenge it with no action and without spending a use.
Reaction when a creature within your reach attacks your VIP: make one weapon attack against it first. On a hit, deal +1d8 damage and its attack has disadvantage.

Action, 1 use per rest: a creature within 60 ft that understands you makes a Judgment roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Confidence or Might modifier) or obeys a one-word command (halt, kneel, drop, flee, approach) on its next turn.
Unbreakable Guard costs no uses when you protect your VIP, and it works within 30 ft (you move next to the VIP first without provoking).
You can have two VIPs. While within 30 ft of you, each VIP has +2 AC and resists damage from creatures you've Challenged.
1 use per long rest, reaction when a VIP within 30 ft takes damage: you take all of it instead. For the next minute you can take one extra reaction each round.

Choose permanently. Point-Blank: no disadvantage on ranged attacks for being within 5 ft of an enemy. Longshot: your ranged weapons' normal and long ranges increase by half, and you ignore half cover at long range.
Bonus action: your next ranged weapon attack this turn has advantage. Proficiency Bonus uses per rest.
