Action, 1 use per rest: make one ranged attack against each creature you choose within a 10-ft radius of a point in range (one ammunition each).
1 use per rest: when you hit with a ranged attack, the shot continues to a second creature in a straight line behind the first; roll a separate attack against it.
Bonus action, 1 use per rest: make three ranged weapon attacks against marked or favored enemies.
1 use per rest: a ranged attack ignores full cover if you know the target's location (the shot curves or punches through).
1 use per long rest: a ranged hit against your marked quarry in sight is automatically a critical hit.

Bond a beast companion (land, air, or water form). Medium, AC 13 + Proficiency Bonus, HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level, speed 40 ft (air: fly 60 ft, HP 4 × Ranger level + 4), your saves. Attack: + Proficiency Bonus + Judgment modifier to hit, 1d8 + Proficiency Bonus damage. It acts on your initiative right after you and Dodges unless you spend a bonus action to command it (or replace one of your attacks with its attack). If it dies, bond a new one after a long rest.
Once per turn, when you hit a creature, your companion can use its reaction to attack that creature.
Your companion gains Evasion. 1 use per rest, it can also halve one attack's damage as a reaction.
Your companion's hits deal your Mark of the Hunter damage (once per turn) against your marked target.
Your companion resists nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and makes death saves instead of dying at 0 HP.
Choose: a second, lesser companion (half HP, no Shared Mark), or your companion grows Large (HP doubled, damage 2d8 + Proficiency Bonus).
Once on each of your turns, your companion makes one attack for free without your command, and you and your companion share Mark of the Hunter concentration (damage to either can't break it).

Two-weapon fighting is built in: you add your ability modifier to off-hand damage, and the off-hand weapon needn't be light if both are finesse. You learn one extra Ranger cantrip and gain expanded spells: choose one illusion or movement Mage spell of a tier you can cast now and at 5, 9, and 13; they count as Ranger spells and are always prepared; your spell DC can use Precision or Judgment.
1 use per rest: after you hit with both weapons on your turn, cast a 1st-tier Ranger spell as a bonus action.
When both of your weapons hit the same creature in one turn, apply or refresh Mark of the Hunter on it without an action or a free cast.
After you Disengage or cast a movement spell, your next dual-wield attack before the end of your next turn has advantage.
When you hit with a melee weapon, spend a slot: +2d8 force for a 1st-tier slot, +1d8 per tier above 1st (max 5d8). Once per turn.
1 use per long rest: concentrate on two Ranger spells at once for 1 minute.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: each Attack action is five finesse strikes (canon said four; raised by one because the Ranger now has 4 attacks at 20); you can replace one with a Ranger cantrip.
At the start of your turn, if you're touching natural wood, earth, or stone, you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + Judgment modifier.
Once per turn, when a Druid spell hits a creature or it fails a save against one, it also makes a Might roll or is restrained until the end of its next turn. Judgment modifier uses per long rest.
1 use per rest: using 5 ft of movement, step into a tree and out of another you know within 500 ft.
Once per long rest, commune with an anchor-bound site within 1 mile and ask the DM three questions about it. While touching the ground you have tremorsense to 30 ft.

Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: a 30-ft-radius grove within 60 ft. Allies starting their turn in it regain Judgment modifier HP; it's difficult terrain for enemies, and an enemy entering it for the first time on a turn makes a Might roll or is restrained (save ends).
Bark Ward temporary HP doubles. Living Grove has a 60-ft radius and 2 uses per long rest.

Action, 1 use per long rest: roots erupt within 60 ft of you. Enemies there make a Might roll, taking 10d8 bludgeoning and being restrained for 1 minute on a failure (save ends), or half damage on a success.
You can Wild Shape as a bonus action, and your CR limit is your Druid level ÷ 3 (minimum 1) if higher than the table. While shaped, bonus action: spend a slot to regain 1d8 HP per slot tier.
Your beast attacks count as magical, and once per turn a beast hit deals +1d8 force.
Spend two Wild Shape uses to become an air, earth, fire, or water elemental of CR up to your limit + 1.

Bonus action, no use spent: keep your own body and statistics but gain natural weapons (magical, 1d10 + Judgment modifier, Judgment to hit), +2 AC, and one beast movement mode (climb, swim, or 30 ft fly) for 10 minutes.

While shaped, your first hit each turn deals +2d8, and you have advantage on attacks against creatures below half HP. When you shift, creatures you choose within 30 ft make a Judgment roll or are frightened of you for 1 minute (save ends). (Circle of Beasts keeps this name; the Berserker's L30 title is Wrathborn.)
When you shift, combine the traits of up to three beasts you've seen: all their movement modes and senses, and one special attack from each.
Once per turn, as part of your movement, shift into another form without spending a use. Your form pool becomes 4 × Druid level.

After each long rest choose a season. Spring: your healing spells restore +Judgment modifier HP. Summer: once per spell, add Judgment modifier to fire or radiant damage. Autumn: a creature that fails your spell's save has -1d4 on its next save. Winter: creatures you deal cold damage to lose 10 ft of speed until your next turn.

Action, concentration up to 10 minutes, 1 use per rest: within 60 ft of you call rain (lightly obscured, extinguishes flames), gale (ranged weapon attacks have disadvantage), fog (heavily obscured), or heat (allies resist cold).

Action, 1 minute, 1 use per rest: flip a 30-ft-radius zone within 60 ft. Spring: allies starting their turn there regain 1d6 HP. Summer: enemies starting there take 2d6 fire. Autumn: enemies there have disadvantage on Judgment rolls. Winter: difficult terrain, and enemies starting there take 2d6 cold.

As a Wild Shape option, become a living storm: fly 60 ft (hover), resist lightning and thunder, and creatures you choose that start their turn within 10 ft make a Precision roll or take 2d8 lightning.
You hold two Seasonal Boons at once, and you can change them on a short rest.
You hold all four Seasonal Boons. Sudden Season has a 60-ft radius and 2 uses per rest.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: a 120-ft radius around you becomes the season of your choice, applying Sudden Season effects with doubled dice.
When you rage, you can choose to frenzy: for that rage you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns. When the rage ends, you gain 1 level of exhaustion.
While raging, you're immune to being charmed or frightened; such effects on you end when you enter a rage.
Reaction when a creature within 5 ft damages you: make one melee weapon attack against it.
Your first frenzy each long rest causes no exhaustion, and a short rest removes one level of exhaustion gained from frenzy.
Once per turn, when you drop a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, move up to 10 ft (no opportunity attacks) and make one more melee weapon attack.
Your frenzy bonus action makes two melee weapon attacks instead of one.
Action while raging, 1 use per long rest: move up to your speed without provoking, and make one melee weapon attack against each creature that comes within your reach during the move.
While raging, you gain +1 AC (stacks with Unarmored Defense or armor).
Reaction while raging, when you're hit: reduce the damage by 1d10 + Endurance modifier. Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest.
1 use per rest, when you enter a rage: for that rage, allies adjacent to you reduce bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage they take by your Endurance modifier.
While raging: forced movement against you is reduced by 10 ft, you have advantage on checks to shove or grapple, and a creature that fails to move you takes your Rage damage bonus.
While raging, difficult terrain doesn't slow you, and you can move through the space of a Large or smaller hostile creature; it makes a Might roll or falls prone.
While raging, critical hits against you become normal hits, and Thick Skin becomes +3 AC.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: reduce all damage you take by your Endurance modifier + Proficiency Bonus, and allies adjacent to you resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
While you're at or below half your HP (bloodied), once per turn your melee hits deal +1d6.
Once per turn, when you score a critical hit or drop a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, regain 1d10 + Endurance modifier HP.
You know the location of any bloodied creature within 60 ft that isn't behind total cover, and you have advantage on checks to track bloodied creatures.

Once per turn, when you hit while raging, the target bleeds: it takes 1d6 slashing at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute (Endurance roll at the end of each of its turns ends it; doesn't stack).

Bonus action while raging, 1 use per rest: enemies within 10 ft make a Endurance roll, taking 4d8 necrotic and starting to bleed (as Hemorrhage) on a failure, or half damage on a success. You regain HP equal to half the total damage dealt.
While raging, Blood Fracas applies even when you aren't bloodied, and its die becomes a d10.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: your melee attacks score a critical hit on 18–20 against bloodied creatures, and Crimson Feed has no once-per-turn limit.
Your speed increases by 10 ft. If you move at least 20 ft on your turn before your first unarmed strike, that strike has advantage.
Once per turn, when the Tiger's Rush strike hits, the target makes a Might roll or falls prone.
Each Flurry strike that hits deals an extra 1d4 slashing damage.
Bonus action, 1 Grit: mark a creature for 1 minute. You know where it is within 60 ft, and your first strike against it each turn has advantage.
When you hit the same creature with three or more strikes in one turn, the last one deals +2d8 and the creature can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
Your speed increases by another 20 ft, Tiger's Rush needs only 10 ft of movement, and you can move after striking without provoking from the creature you struck.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: the Tiger's Rush advantage applies to all your strikes, and once per turn a hit on a prone creature deals +2d8.
Once per turn, when you hit with an unarmed strike, you can also try to grapple the target (Large or smaller; Might or Precision roll vs your class DC). You can still Flurry while grappling.
You gain +1 AC, and at the start of each of your turns while you're grappling a creature you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Your strikes against a creature you're grappling deal +1d8.
A creature you grapple has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you and on checks or saves to escape, and it can't teleport.
Bonus action, 1 use per rest: gain temporary HP equal to twice your Pugilist level and advantage on Endurance rolls for 1 minute.
You can grapple two creatures at once and grapple Huge creatures. Maul becomes 2d8.
Action, 1 use per long rest: a creature you're grappling makes a Endurance roll, taking 10d10 bludgeoning and being stunned until the end of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.
While unarmored, you gain +1 AC.
1 use per rest: when you hit, the target's AC drops by 2 until the end of your next turn.
When you hit, spend 1 Grit: the target makes a Might roll or is pushed 15 ft and knocked prone.
1 use per rest: when you hit, the target's armor stops counting until the end of your next turn (its AC becomes 10 + Precision modifier + shield or natural bonus).
Your strikes deal double damage to objects and structures and +1d8 to constructs.
Iron Bones becomes +3 AC. Break Guard can be used once per turn by spending 1 Grit.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: you can't be moved or knocked prone, and each of your hits lowers the target's AC by 1 (max -5) until the effect ends.
While an ally within 5 ft of you wields a polearm or reach weapon, you and that ally gain +1 AC.
Allies within 5 ft of you have half cover against attacks from creatures that are closer to you than to them.
You and allies within 10 ft of you have advantage on saves and checks against being shoved, pushed, or knocked prone.
When you use Brace / Skewer, one ally within 10 ft wielding a melee weapon can use its reaction to attack the same creature.
Allies within 10 ft of you who wield polearms gain your Reach Tactics benefit.
Lockstep becomes +2 AC, and Wall of Points grants three-quarters cover.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: you and allies within 15 ft can't be moved or knocked prone, and each of them can make one opportunity attack per round without spending a reaction.
Your standing jumps cover the distance of running jumps. Once per turn, if you jump at least 10 ft right before a melee attack, it deals +1d8.
Your jump distance doubles, and your jumps don't provoke opportunity attacks.
1 use per rest: after you jump or while you're above your target, you have advantage on all your attacks this turn.

Action, 1 use per rest: leap up to 60 ft and land in a space you can see, taking no falling damage. Creatures within 5 ft of where you land make a Precision roll, taking 4d10 piercing and falling prone on a failure, or half damage on a success.

Bonus action: hook a surface or creature within your reach + 10 ft and pull yourself next to it. When you hit a flying creature, it makes a Might roll or is dragged down to the ground within your reach and knocked prone.
On your turn you have a 30 ft fly speed as long as you end your move on a surface. Dragoon Descent has 2 uses per rest.

1 use per long rest, replacing a Dragoon Descent: leap up to 120 ft; creatures within 20 ft of where you land make a Precision roll, taking 10d10 force and falling prone on a failure, or half on a success. Then make one polearm attack against each creature within your reach.

While wielding a spear in each hand you gain the Two-Weapon (dual spears) style benefits (if you already have it, swap it for another Lancer style). Once per turn, when both spears hit the same creature on your turn, Measured Thrust slows it by 20 ft instead of 10.
While wielding a spear in each hand you gain +1 AC. From level 7, your Haft Parry bonus also applies to every other attack the same creature makes against you that turn.
While dual-wielding, Brace / Skewer attacks with both spears (two rolls). The +1d8 applies to one hit of your choice; the stop applies if either hits.
Your off-hand bonus action makes two attacks with the off-hand spear instead of one.
Once per round, when you make an opportunity attack while dual-wielding, attack with each spear as part of the same reaction.
Once per turn, when you hit a creature with one spear after hitting it with the other earlier that turn, the second hit is a critical hit.

Action, 1 use per rest: move up to your speed without provoking. Make one attack with each spear against each creature that comes within your reach during the move (max one per spear per creature); Measured Thrust can apply to each creature hit.
You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet this combat, and any hit you score against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Bonus action while in dim light or darkness: teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness you can see. Your next melee attack this turn has advantage.
Once per turn, when you deal Sneak Attack damage on your turn, you can make one more weapon attack as a bonus action (it can't deal Sneak Attack).
When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Endurance roll against your class DC; on a failure, the attack's damage is doubled.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per rest: a shadow clone appears within 30 ft (your AC, 1 HP). It counts as an ally for Sneak Attack, moves 30 ft when you use a bonus action to command it, and you can Shadow Step into its space.
Living Shadow has HP equal to your Assassin level and 2 uses per rest; when you take the Attack action, the clone can make one weapon attack using your bonus (no Sneak Attack).
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: darkness you can see through fills 15 ft around you, you're invisible while in dim light or darkness, and your Sneak Attack dice become d8s.

uses: Proficiency Bonus doses per long rest
description: After each long rest you have basic doses equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Bonus action: coat a weapon for 1 minute or until it hits. On the hit, the target takes +2d6 poison and makes a Endurance roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Precision modifier) or is poisoned until the end of its next turn.
When a creature fails the save against your dose, also choose one: speed halved, no reactions, or disadvantage on its next attack roll (until the end of its next turn).
You resist poison damage. When a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, it takes poison damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
1 use per rest: one dose ignores poison resistance and immunity to the poisoned condition.

Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per long rest (or spend 2 doses): a 20-ft-radius toxic cloud within 60 ft, heavily obscured. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Endurance roll, taking 6d8 poison on a failure or half on a success.
You're immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. You have 2 × Proficiency Bonus doses, and dose damage becomes 4d6.

1 use per long rest, on a coated hit: the target makes a Endurance roll. On a failure it drops to 0 HP; on a success it takes 10d10 poison. Story-gated legends instead take 10d10 poison and are poisoned for 1 minute.
During a short rest, craft a disguise; you have advantage on checks to pass as someone else while wearing it. You can mimic any voice you've heard for at least 1 minute.
You leave no tracks or scent and can't be tracked by nonmagical means. You don't take a Stealth penalty for moving at a normal pace.
Action, 1 use per rest: after studying a creature for 1 minute, take its exact appearance and voice for 1 hour. Only truesight sees through it.
1 per rest: when you Hide in dim light or darkness, you are invisible until the end of your next turn.
1 use per rest: as part of your movement, pass through one wall, door, or barrier up to 10 ft thick.
You can't be targeted by divination or perceived through scrying. Creatures that aren't hostile don't notice you unless you interact with them.
Action, 1 use per long rest: each non-legend creature of your choice within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll or forgets everything you did in the last hour; hostile ones lose track of you.

Bonus action: mark one creature you can see within 30 ft (lasts 1 minute or until you mark another). It takes +1d6 radiant from your hits (once per turn) and has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you.
When your marked target escapes your restraint or moves out of your reach, make one weapon attack against it as a reaction; if it hits, Sigil Strike costs 0.
Action, 2 embers, gain 1 Crack: 20-ft aura on you for 1 minute (no concentration); enemies' speed is halved in it.
Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage while at 3+ Cracks.

Action, 1 use per long rest: a marked creature within your reach with 50 HP or fewer (100 from 28) makes a Endurance roll (class DC). Fail: it drops to 0 HP. Success: it takes 6d8 radiant. The use is spent either way; legendary-resistance-style features work as normal.
You can have up to 3 marks at once.
On a failed Breach save, every marked target is stunned until the end of its next turn instead of you (no Archon Breach effect). Sentence Passed works on targets with 100 HP or fewer.
As an attack, make a 60-ft ranged radiant bolt: 1d8 + Intellect radiant. It counts as a sigil weapon hit for Sigil Strike and Crack damage.

Wrested Wings gives no Crack, and you can hover. Before you gain Wrested Wings at level 9: when you fall, you descend no faster than 60 ft per round, take no falling damage, and move 2 ft horizontally for every 1 ft you fall.
Action, 2 embers, gain 1 Crack: 15-ft burst on you; Endurance roll (class DC): 4d8 radiant and blinded until the end of your next turn; half and not blinded on a success.
Enemies that start their turn within 10 ft of you take radiant damage equal to your Cracks.
If you fly 30+ ft in a straight line toward a target and hit it with a melee attack that turn, double the Sigil Strike dice (once per turn).
Radiant Lash can be a 60-ft cone instead of a line.
While at 5 Cracks, at the start of each of your turns roll a d6; on 5-6, your next Radiant Lash this turn costs no embers.
Heavy armor proficiency. When Soul Strike hits, you can push the target 5 ft.
While your devil has crossed over, allies adjacent to it gain +2 AC.
Bonus action, once per turn, gain 1 Strain: allies within 15 ft can each use their reaction to make one weapon attack.
At 3+ Strain, you can't be pushed or knocked prone.
Bonus action, 1 per long rest, 1 minute: an enemy must succeed on a Might roll (class DC) to move away from you.
30-ft aura: allies add 1d4 to attack rolls.
Crossing effect: on a failed control save, the devil guards you and attacks your enemies instead of acting freely.

Gain medium armor and proficiency with the Broad One-Handed, Versatile and Ranged Two-Handed weapon categories. A creature holding your Inspiration die can add it to one weapon damage roll, or to its AC against one attack (reaction).
Starting Countercharm ends frightened on allies within 30 ft, and each ally it frees gains temp HP equal to your Confidence modifier + Proficiency Bonus.
You make 2 attacks when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one of them with a Songsmith cantrip.
Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon or a cantrip, deal +2d6 thunder; the target makes a Might roll or is pushed 10 ft.
Bonus action, 1 use per rest: allies within 30 ft can each use a reaction to move up to half their speed without provoking, and their next attack before the end of their next turn has advantage.
Combat Anthem gives +2 to attack rolls and reaches 30 ft.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: allies within 30 ft are immune to being frightened or charmed and gain temporary HP equal to your Songsmith level at the start of each of their turns.

Reaction when a creature within 60 ft that you can see makes an attack roll, check, or damage roll: spend an Inspiration use and subtract the die from the roll. You also gain proficiency in 3 skills of your choice.
You understand every spoken language, and any creature that knows a language understands what you say.
When you make an ability check, you can spend an Inspiration use to add the die (after seeing the roll).
Learn two more Magical Secrets-lite spells; after each long rest you can swap one of your Secrets for another.
1 use per long rest: cast any spell of 5th tier or lower that you've seen cast, using one of your slots; it counts as a Songsmith spell.
Once per round, Cutting Words doesn't spend a use.

Action, 1 use per long rest: each creature of your choice within 60 ft makes a Judgment roll or is enthralled for 1 minute: incapacitated and speed 0, ending if it takes damage (legends can spend a legendary resistance).
During a short rest, bond with up to 2 weapons you're proficient with. You can't be disarmed of a bonded weapon while conscious, and as a bonus action you can call one to your hand from within 60 ft.

You gain 4 maneuver dice (d8; d10 at 14, d12 at 24), regained on a short or long rest. Learn 3 maneuvers (one more at 10, 14, and 18): Trip (target makes a Might roll vs your class DC or falls prone), Disarm (Might roll or drops an item), Riposte (reaction attack when a creature misses you in melee), Precision (add the die to an attack roll after seeing it), Push (Might roll or pushed 15 ft), Rally (an ally gains temp HP equal to the die + Might modifier). Add the die to the attack's damage when the maneuver hits.
Once per turn, when you hit with a bonded weapon, add one maneuver die to the damage without spending it (roll it; no maneuver effect).

At the start of each of your turns choose a form until your next turn: Offense (+2 damage on weapon hits), Guard (+1 AC), or Flow (+10 ft speed and your movement doesn't provoke). Maneuver dice become d10.
Gain a 5th maneuver die. Once per turn when you score a critical hit or drop a creature to 0 HP, regain 1 maneuver die.
Maneuver dice become d12. Once per turn you can apply two different maneuvers to the same hit, spending a die for each.
Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: maneuvers don't spend dice (you still roll them), and attacks with bonded weapons score a critical hit on 18–20.

Bonus action, Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest: you become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, and your next attack roll before then has advantage. Oath spells: False Face, Mark of the Hunter (3rd tier at 9: Terror Wave, Scryshroud).
When you hit a creature, it's marked until the end of your next turn. While a marked enemy is in your aura, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you.
Your Divine Smite deals +2d8 psychic when the target can't see you or you're hidden or invisible.
Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per rest: magical darkness fills a 30-ft radius around you and moves with you. You and allies in your aura can see through it.

Your Avatar form grants a fear gaze: as a bonus action each turn, one creature within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll or is frightened of you until the end of its next turn. Your smites deal psychic or necrotic (your choice) and add +1d8.
In dim light or darkness, Veil Step costs no uses and doesn't end when you attack.

Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: choose a creature you can see. You always know where it is, it can't teleport or turn invisible to you, your attacks against it have advantage, and once per turn a smite against it uses maximum dice.
